id: C7 land value tax (Jake's real game, close round)
motion: This House believes land value tax is better than property tax
playerText: A LVT incentivizes productive land use, which is a finite resource as landlords will be taxed on the value of the land not the property on it. Meaning, more duplexes and apartments will be built to get a higher ROI in rent. This would also drop house prices with more supply
aiText: Land value tax sounds neat until you think about the retired couple who bought their house decades ago. Their area gets trendy, the land's suddenly worth a fortune, and they get a huge tax bill they can't pay without any extra money coming in.
